located_observations.observation: Explanation is larger and left aligned in three lines. The last line contains only 배웁니다.; first two lines carry nearly all the sentence.
Event/date/time/place are larger than initial. Fee/deadline/invitation remain visibly smaller than the left group and still crowded into a single invitation line.
Contrasting white stitches are now visible along the torn edge being pinched; the threaded needle lies on table nearby.
Larger screw heads were added on the chair. The free hand still grips the chair's back slat; the screw-tightening operation is not shown. The exchange and hand ownership remain clear.
Large opposing chair and fabric framing and upper hand-to-hand tool transfer are retained. The title remains strongly dominant over the practical body.
